name: Personal Pack
description: Offline email triage, calendar summaries and meeting minutes from files you export, combined into a daily briefing.

agents.name: Email Triager
agents.description: Sorts exported emails (.eml, .mbox, text) from your working folder into what needs action, replies or reading, and drafts short replies. Fully offline.

agents.name: Calendar Summarizer
agents.description: Reads exported calendars (.ics or CSV) from your working folder and summarizes your day or week, including conflicts, prep needed, focus time and a daily briefing.

agents.name: Meeting Notes
agents.description: Turns meeting transcripts or rough notes from your working folder into clean minutes with decisions, owners, due dates and a follow-up email draft.
